headline: On October 18, 2019: First All-Female Spacewalk
captionCards: Meir and Koch replaced a power controller in space
This event showcased the growing role of women in space
instagramCaption:
Jessica Meir and Christina Koch make history in space.\nNASA astronauts Jessica Meir and Christina Koch conducted the first all-female spacewalk on October 18, 2019. They ventured out of the International Space Station to replace a power controller. This milestone was part of their duties with the NASA Astronaut Corps, based at Johnson Space Center in Houston, Texas. The event highlighted the growing role of women in space exploration.
